OrderConfirmation.thankYou: Thank you for your order. Your order number is
OrderConfirmation.emailConfirmation: We'll send you an email with your order details and tracking information.
OrderConfirmation.transferIntro: Your order is reserved and we will prepare it as soon as we confirm your transfer. Use the order code as the payment reference.
OrderConfirmation.mpConfirmingText: We are waiting for Mercado Pago to confirm. This page updates by itself; you can leave it open.
OrderConfirmation.mpConfirmingSlow: This is taking longer than usual. If you already paid, don't worry: as soon as Mercado Pago confirms it you will see your order here and we will email you.
OrderConfirmation.mpNotPaidText: Your order is still open, but there is no payment registered yet. You can go back to finish paying.
OrderConfirmation.mpRejectedTitle: Mercado Pago did not approve the payment
OrderConfirmation.mpRejectedText: The charge was not completed. You can try again with another card or another payment method.
OrderConfirmation.mpReviewTitle: We received your payment and are reviewing it
OrderConfirmation.mpReviewText: There was an issue registering your order. Please do not pay again: we will contact you to confirm it.
